details: Filled rectangles: color, stroke, width, selection, undo, reopen and vector-print coverage
Native private text, invisible OCR text, scanned image text and nested form content
Partial inline redaction retaining words on both sides
CJK text, intrinsic page rotation, rotated view and nonzero CropBox
Private metadata, annotation data, attachments, JavaScript, outlines and incremental history absent from fresh copy
Opaque masks are baked into RGB pixels, not removable overlays
Searchable output omits text behind redactions and existing opaque Mini PDF rectangles
Independent PDF readers agree on image mode and public searchable text
600 dpi A4 retains requested resolution beyond 24 megapixels
Source bytes preserved, original overwrite rejected, canceled export leaves no output or temporary file
Actual isolated worker streaming, atomic destination replacement and progress cancellation
Markers: cross-page, per-tab, undo, close cancellation and document-edit invalidation
Pending marks pause external refresh; clearing resumes refresh
Native dialogs inspected at local display scale; complete EXE startup, Unicode paths and runtime cleanup
limits: Both output modes rebuild page appearance as images; they do not retain original vector objects or font editing. Searchable mode rebuilds only a copy/search text layer outside redactions.
Searchable reconstruction depends on reliable original character coordinates. Use image-only output for malformed or misleading source text geometry.
The original file is retained. Only the exported sanitized copy is redacted.
No universal PDF-compatibility certification or OCR accuracy score is implied by these fixtures. Physical printing and unchanged AI models were not newly exercised.
